svg.aria-label: Eager reliable broadcast: Everybody relays what it delivers, so a crash mid-broadcast cannot leave half the system out.. ⟨DATA, m⟩ to everybody; the sender crashes here; deliver m; relay ⟨DATA, m⟩ before delivering; deliver m as well. If one correct process delivers, it has already relayed: all or none, whatever the sender does.
